opener_concept: A right-angled triangular flag (edges 4 m and 10 m): area by common sense = half of the 40 m rectangle = 20. The reveal names this as half base times height, then shows the true height of a tilted triangle shrinks to (side x sinC), so Area = half a b sinC, with sin90 = 1 recovering the right-angle case. Establishes the sinC factor that powers the area formula, sine rule and cosine rule. (Unchanged in this revision.)
